product_context.name: Samsung Galaxy M35 5G
product_context.description: Samsung Galaxy M35 5G is a mid-range smartphone featuring a 6.6-inch Super AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, Exynos 1380 processor, 50MP main camera with OIS, 6000mAh battery, 25W charging, and 5G connectivity. It runs on Samsung One UI and offers features for everyday smartphone use, entertainment, photography, and multitasking.

response_text: Good for everyday use but not the best value for the price.

construct_responses.PE: The 120Hz display makes scrolling and using multiple apps smooth. The 50MP camera takes good photos, but 5G and OIS are not as critical for daily tasks.
construct_responses.EE: Easy to set up with a familiar interface. Navigation is intuitive, but some advanced settings might be harder to learn.
construct_responses.HM: Pleasant to use with a good display and long battery. However, no OIS and 5G might limit its appeal for outdoor photography and video calls.
construct_responses.SI: Friends might think it's a solid choice, but not a top-tier one. It's reliable and functional but not flashy.
construct_responses.PP: The product doesn't mention any security features, so I can't feel safe using it for personal information.
construct_responses.BI: No, the price feels a bit high for the features I care about.
construct_responses.OVERALL: Good for everyday use but not the best value for the price.
